# Tadashi

> Japanese Restaurant in Bee Cave, Texas. Executive Chef Sun Il slices fish flown in from Tsukiji market and beyond. The rest is made in-house.

- Address: 12820 Hill Country Blvd E-105, Bee Cave, TX 78738
- Areas: Bee Cave, Lakeway, Dripping Springs, Austin, Cedar Park
- Offers: Sushi & sashimi; Omakase; Bento & kitchen plates
